sv.title: Sverige nollat av Kanada i VM-semifinalen
sv.summary: Kanada nollade Sverige i VM-semifinalen. För Damkronorna väntar nu bronsmatch mot Finland.

en.title: Sweden shut out by Canada in World Championship semi-final
en.summary: Canada shut out Sweden in the World Championship semi-final. Damkronorna now face Finland in the bronze medal match.
